The '''Green Belt''' is an {{Uncommon}} [[Belts|Belt]]. It is obtainable from {{NPCSprite|Master Tao}} after reaching 2000 points in the {{Zone|Dojo}}. It gives {{Stat|health|+20}} and {{Stat|def|+10}}. Its ability reduces all damage taken by {{Green|3%}}. This item is automatically {{DG|Soulbound}} upon receiving it. It can be upgraded into the {{Item|Blue Belt}}, and is a direct upgrade from the {{Item|Yellow Belt}}.
